draft_fields.description: Voicy is a focused tool for enhancing recorded speech on Apple Silicon Macs. It runs AuK locally with bundled models, without an account or audio upload. Import a recording, compare original and enhanced versions, then export a mono WAV. It is intended for speech cleanup, not transcription, a full recording studio, live microphone filtering or music mastering. macOS 14 or later is required. Allow storage for the bundled models and time for processing. Generative enhancement can change words or voice texture, so listen to the complete result before publishing.

draft_fields.tagline: Clean up speech locally on your Apple Silicon Mac
draft_fields.description: Free, open-source speech enhancement for Apple Silicon Macs. Process recordings locally with AuK, compare original and enhanced audio, and export WAV. No account or audio upload. macOS 14+; large model download required.
draft_fields.topics_note: Choose available platform topics at submission, at most three; availability not verified in authenticated form.
draft_fields.maker_comment: Voicy focuses on local speech cleanup for Apple Silicon. Models are included so recordings can be processed on the Mac without an upload or account. The workflow is import, enhance, compare, and export WAV. It is a focused alternative to Adobe Podcast Enhance Speech, not a replacement for every Studio feature. The tradeoffs are a large model download, hardware requirements and processing time. Generative enhancement can alter words or voice texture, so review the complete result before publishing. Application source is MIT licensed, while models and dependencies retain their own licenses. The official site links to the source, demo, requirements and comparison method. Feedback on import, comparison and export would help prioritize improvements.
draft_fields.maker_comment_note: Project-description draft only; no invented personal origin story, user counts, listening panel, superiority score or claim of independent review.
